lines.text: David prays for God to hear him, because the wicked pressure him and the terrors of death assail him.
David wishes for wings like a dove so he could flee far away and remain in the Negev.
David asks the Lord to confuse their speech because he sees violence and strife in the city.
The one who turned on David is his close friend, with whom he walked into the house of God.
David calls to God and cries out in distress at dawn, noon, and night, and God hears his voice.
